description: Defines the TimedEventQueue class for managing timed events, including event posting, cancellation, and execution control within the Android media framework.

classes.name: TimedEventQueue
classes.description: Manages a queue of timed events, allowing posting, cancellation, and execution control.

classes.name: TimedEventQueue::Event
classes.description: Abstract base class for events that can be scheduled in the TimedEventQueue.

classes.name: TimedEventQueue::StopEvent
classes.description: Special event to stop the event queue.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the event loop, optionally flushing pending events.

methods.name: postEvent
methods.description: Posts an event to the front of the queue.

methods.name: postEventToBack
methods.description: Posts an event to the back of the queue.

methods.name: postEventWithDelay
methods.description: Posts an event with a specified delay.

methods.name: postTimedEvent
methods.description: Posts an event to occur at a specific real-time.

methods.name: cancelEvent
methods.description: Cancels a specific event by ID.

methods.name: getRealTimeUs
methods.description: Returns the current real-time in microseconds.
